fields.english: to the art of the voice.

fields.key: copy:Opera, stage and roots. The artistic world of a Dominican soprano trained in Vienna.
fields.source: Ópera, escenario y raíces. El universo artístico de una soprano dominicana formada en Viena.
fields.english: Opera, stage and roots. The artistic world of a Dominican soprano trained in Vienna.
fields.label: Descripción

fields.source: Nominada al Latin Grammy por Alta Gracia, ha actuado en el Musikverein de Viena y debutó como actriz en el Los Angeles Theater Center. Desde 2019 es embajadora cultural de la República Dominicana.
fields.english: A Latin Grammy nominee for Alta Gracia, she has performed at Vienna’s Musikverein and made her acting debut at the Los Angeles Theater Center. She has served as Cultural Ambassador for the Dominican Republic since 2019.
fields.label: Párrafo 1

fields.key: copy:Born in Santo Domingo and trained at Vienna’s University of Music and Performing Arts, Nathalie Peña-Comas brings together opera and Latin American repertoire.
fields.source: Nacida en Santo Domingo y formada en la Universidad de Música y Artes Escénicas de Viena, Nathalie Peña-Comas une la ópera y el repertorio latinoamericano.
fields.english: Born in Santo Domingo and trained at Vienna’s University of Music and Performing Arts, Nathalie Peña-Comas brings together opera and Latin American repertoire.
fields.label: Párrafo 1

fields.key: copy:From Mozart to Verdi, Pamina to Violetta, her artistic journey also embraces theatre and chamber music with Ensemble Spirituosi. She has served as Cultural Ambassador for the Dominican Republic since 2019.
fields.source: De Mozart a Verdi, de Pamina a Violetta, su recorrido artístico se extiende también al teatro y a la música de cámara con Ensemble Spirituosi. Es embajadora cultural de la República Dominicana desde 2019.
fields.english: From Mozart to Verdi, Pamina to Violetta, her artistic journey also embraces theatre and chamber music with Ensemble Spirituosi. She has served as Cultural Ambassador for the Dominican Republic since 2019.
fields.label: Párrafo 2

fields.source: Primer premio · Concurso internacional de ópera, 2022
fields.label: Texto

fields.key: copy:Andrea Bocelli · Ramón Vargas · Ensemble Spirituosi
fields.source: Andrea Bocelli · Ramón Vargas · Ensemble Spirituosi
fields.english: Andrea Bocelli · Ramón Vargas · Ensemble Spirituosi
fields.label: Texto

fields.key: copy:From the European operatic tradition to the soul of Latin American music. A career connecting cultures.
fields.source: De la tradición operística europea al alma de la música latinoamericana. Una trayectoria que une culturas.
fields.english: From the European operatic tradition to the soul of Latin American music. A career connecting cultures.
fields.label: Descripción

fields.key: copy:A voice returning to its essence. An invitation to feel music at its roots.
fields.source: La voz vuelve a su esencia. Una invitación a sentir la música desde la raíz.
fields.english: A voice returning to its essence. An invitation to feel music at its roots.
fields.label: Descripción

fields.key: copy:In the press, behind the scenes and on stage. A selection from the official archive.
fields.source: En los medios, entre bastidores y sobre el escenario. Una selección del archivo oficial.
fields.english: In the press, behind the scenes and on stage. A selection from the official archive.
fields.label: Descripción

fields.source: Nathalie Peña-Comas — portada de Oh! Magazine
fields.label: Texto

fields.key: copy:Her press archive includes covers and articles from Oh! Magazine, En Sociedad and Corriere Romagna, among other publications. The cover shown here is part of that official selection.
fields.source: Su archivo de prensa reúne portadas y artículos de Oh! Magazine, En Sociedad y Corriere Romagna, entre otros medios. La portada reproducida forma parte de esa selección oficial.
fields.english: Her press archive includes covers and articles from Oh! Magazine, En Sociedad and Corriere Romagna, among other publications. The cover shown here is part of that official selection.
fields.label: Párrafo 1

fields.key: copy:The official programme announced the album presentation on 13 October 2026 at Teatro Nacional Eduardo Brito, Santo Domingo. Explore the project and its performances on music platforms.
fields.source: El programa oficial anunció la presentación del álbum el 13 de octubre de 2026 en el Teatro Nacional Eduardo Brito, Santo Domingo. Descubre el proyecto y sus interpretaciones en las plataformas musicales.
fields.english: The official programme announced the album presentation on 13 October 2026 at Teatro Nacional Eduardo Brito, Santo Domingo. Explore the project and its performances on music platforms.
fields.label: Párrafo 2

fields.key: copy:The official archive announced Nathalie’s participation in a Larimar Films documentary on the history of devotion to Our Lady of Altagracia, a figure deeply connected to Dominican culture.
fields.source: El archivo oficial anunció la participación de Nathalie en un documental de Larimar Films sobre la historia de la devoción a la Virgen de la Altagracia, una figura profundamente ligada a la cultura dominicana.
fields.english: The official archive announced Nathalie’s participation in a Larimar Films documentary on the history of devotion to Our Lady of Altagracia, a figure deeply connected to Dominican culture.
fields.label: Párrafo 3

fields.key: copy:Wiener Opernsommer presented Nathalie’s role debut as Donna Anna in Mozart’s Don Giovanni. The production was announced for July 2024 at Vienna’s Belvedere Palace.
fields.source: El Wiener Opernsommer presentó a Nathalie en su debut como Donna Anna en Don Giovanni de Mozart. La producción se anunció para julio de 2024 en el palacio Belvedere de Viena.
fields.english: Wiener Opernsommer presented Nathalie’s role debut as Donna Anna in Mozart’s Don Giovanni. The production was announced for July 2024 at Vienna’s Belvedere Palace.
fields.label: Párrafo 4

fields.source: Ensemble Spirituosi — fotografía oficial del sexteto

fields.key: copy:Nathalie’s voice, Evelyn’s flute and Nicole Peña-Comas’s cello meet the guitars of Damien Lancelle and Gonzalo Manrique and Rubén Sánchez’s double bass.
fields.source: La voz de Nathalie, la flauta de Evelyn y el violonchelo de Nicole Peña-Comas se encuentran con las guitarras de Damien Lancelle y Gonzalo Manrique y el contrabajo de Rubén Sánchez.
fields.english: Nathalie’s voice, Evelyn’s flute and Nicole Peña-Comas’s cello meet the guitars of Damien Lancelle and Gonzalo Manrique and Rubén Sánchez’s double bass.
fields.label: Párrafo 1

fields.key: copy:A sextet connecting classical music with Latin American and Caribbean traditions. Their album Souvenir Latino received three gold medals at the 2018 Global Music Awards.
fields.source: Un sexteto que enlaza música clásica y tradiciones de América Latina y el Caribe. Su álbum Souvenir Latino recibió tres medallas de oro en los Global Music Awards 2018.
fields.english: A sextet connecting classical music with Latin American and Caribbean traditions. Their album Souvenir Latino received three gold medals at the 2018 Global Music Awards.
fields.label: Párrafo 2

fields.key: copy:Audience measurement and advertising are disabled by default. If configured, Google Analytics 4 and Meta Pixel load only after you consent to the relevant category. They may record visits and music platform clicks, including destination, language and link section. You can reject both categories without limiting navigation.
fields.source: La medición de audiencia y la publicidad están desactivadas por defecto. Cuando se configuren, Google Analytics 4 y Meta Pixel solo se cargarán después de tu consentimiento para la categoría correspondiente. Podrán registrar visitas y clics hacia plataformas musicales, con el destino, idioma y sección del enlace. Puedes rechazar ambas categorías sin limitar la navegación.
fields.english: Audience measurement and advertising are disabled by default. If configured, Google Analytics 4 and Meta Pixel load only after you consent to the relevant category. They may record visits and music platform clicks, including destination, language and link section. You can reject both categories without limiting navigation.
fields.label: Párrafo 2

fields.key: copy:If you save a choice, this browser stores your preferences locally for up to 180 days. You can change them or withdraw consent here or in the footer. If storage is blocked, your choice applies only to the current session.
fields.source: Si guardas una elección, este navegador conserva tus preferencias en almacenamiento local durante un máximo de 180 días. Puedes cambiarlas o retirar tu consentimiento aquí o en el pie de página. Si el almacenamiento está bloqueado, tu elección solo se aplica a la sesión actual.
fields.english: If you save a choice, this browser stores your preferences locally for up to 180 days. You can change them or withdraw consent here or in the footer. If storage is blocked, your choice applies only to the current session.

fields.key: copy:Images and fonts are served from this site. YouTube does not load on page visit: first you choose a video, then confirm playback. The player uses youtube-nocookie.com; playback sends connection data to YouTube under its own terms. Spotify, Apple Music and other external destinations also apply their own policies when opened.
fields.source: Las imágenes y las fuentes se sirven desde este sitio. YouTube no se carga al visitar la página: primero eliges un video y después confirmas su reproducción. El reproductor usa youtube-nocookie.com; al reproducirlo, YouTube recibe datos de conexión y aplica sus propias condiciones. Spotify, Apple Music y otros destinos externos también aplican sus políticas al abrirlos.
fields.english: Images and fonts are served from this site. YouTube does not load on page visit: first you choose a video, then confirm playback. The player uses youtube-nocookie.com; playback sends connection data to YouTube under its own terms. Spotify, Apple Music and other external destinations also apply their own policies when opened.
fields.label: Párrafo 4

fields.key: copy:Vercel hosts the site and may process technical connection data to deliver pages. For enquiries about the artist or use of her content, use the representation details in the Contact section.

fields.english: Vercel hosts the site and may process technical connection data to deliver pages. For enquiries about the artist or use of her content, use the representation details in the Contact section.
